com.github.dakusui.actionunit.actions

Interface Ensured

  • All Superinterfaces:
    Action, Formattable
    All Known Implementing Classes:
    Ensured.Impl

    public interface Ensured
extends Action

    An action whose success of the "target" is ensured by the "ensurer" actions.

    How it works?

    Each action returned by Ensured#ensurers() is performed one by one. After an entry from ensurers() is performed successfully, the target action will be performed (target(). If the target is performed successfully, this action finishes immediately and successfully. If this step is tried for all the ensurers but no attempt finishes successfully, the entire action will fail.

    If an exception thrown by a target or an ensurer is not "recoverable", the entire action will fail immediately. Whether it is recoverable or not is determined by the return value of a method Ensured#isRecoverable(Throwable).

    See Also:
    ensurers(), target(), isRecoverable(Throwable)
